about:
Ark Electrical LLC is a family-owned, faith-based electrical contracting company based in Cedar Crest, New Mexico, in the East Mountains region. The business was founded in 2019 by Master Electrician Juan Fernandez, who launched the company after eleven years of hands-on experience in the trade with a mission to bring faith-based honesty, reliability, and quality electrical services to his neighbors.

The company provides full-service residential and commercial electrical work, including new construction, remodels, smart-home conversions, service upgrades, panel replacements, backup generator installation, EV charger installation, and general electrical repairs. Operating with a small team that includes a senior electrical specialist and an apprentice, Ark Electrical emphasizes quality craftsmanship, upfront flat-rate pricing, and a "do it once and do it right" approach on every job.

Ark Electrical serves homeowners and businesses throughout Sandia Park, Cedar Crest, Tijeras, Edgewood, and the greater Albuquerque area. Its residential clients rely on the firm for everything from improving the safety of older electrical systems to integrating modern smart-home technology, while commercial customers engage the company for new builds and remodel projects.

Fernandez started Ark Electrical to combine his trade expertise with values rooted in faith, integrity, honesty, commitment, and respect. The company states that it stands behind its work, prioritizes clear communication, and aims to build lasting relationships with the families and communities it serves.
